text:
jules_se: Quick ask from Aperio procurement  they want a short SIEM/audit evidence packet for the vendor review. POC next week. Need sample admin events, detection example, forwarding options (Splunk HEC/syslog/S3), retention numbers, and immutability notes.

ana_sec: I can draft a tiny bundle. Map to SIG/CAIQ: admin/audit -> CAIQ.AUDIT; monitoring/forwarding -> SIG.MON; retention/immutability -> SIG.RET.

mike_ops: For forwarding we support Splunk HEC (TLS token), syslog (rsyslog), or direct S3 export (gzipped ndjson). Customers can provide an S3 ARN + KMS key; we set Object Lock in GOVERNANCE mode when requested.

ana_sec: Single-line admin event (drop-in): {"event_type":"admin_action","ts":"2026-05-01T09:12:03Z","actor":"u_501","action":"rotate_key","target":"api_key_21","req":"r_210"}

ana_sec: Detection example: {"event_type":"detection","ts":"2026-05-01T09:15:20Z","name":"admin_login_spike","severity":"high","count":47}

mike_ops: Minimal Splunk HEC curl (email-friendly): curl -s https://splunk.aperio.corp:8088/services/collector -H "Authorization: Splunk <HEC-TOKEN>" -d @/var/log/redwood/audit.log

mike_ops: Minimal rsyslog snippet: module(load=\"imfile\")
input(type=\"imfile\" File=\"/var/log/redwood/audit.log\" Tag=\"redwood-audit\")
*.* @@splunk.aperio.corp:514

ana_sec: Retention defaults (Hosted): API logs 90 days hot / 13 months cold; Admin/audit 1 year default (optional archival to customer S3 up to 7 years with Object Lock); Auth events 13 months; Inference metrics 90 days. POC special: we can keep 6 months on request.

ana_sec: One-line security note to paste: "All logs encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Customer-managed KMS supported for S3 archival; audit access is role-restricted and access to logs is itself logged."

jules_se: Perfect  can you pack this into a one-page and attach two single-line examples in the email? Also include SOC contact (ana_sec@redwood.ai) and the SIG/CAIQ mapping.

alert-bot: Exported sample bundle to /shared/sales/aperio/siem-packet at 2026-05-01T09:45:00Z.

jules_se: Sending to Aperio procurement in 10. Marking thread for follow-up if they ask for egress IP ranges or mTLS.

ana_sec: If they require an immutable retention SLA, flag as Dedicated/Private add-on and loop legal.
